_comment: Daily short-form content bank for NihonGo. type 'pitch' = minimal-pair pitch-accent hook (pitch verified against public/pitch-accents.json). type 'grammar' = common learner mistake the AI fixes. Add entries freely; generate-daily.mjs picks one per run.

entries.hook: Your Japanese past tense is WRONG
entries.why: i-adjectives conjugate themselves — never add でした.
〜たい attaches to the verb stem: 行き + たい.

entries.wrong: 私は犬が好きです。私は…
entries.why: Japanese drops the subject once it's known. Don't repeat 私は.
Ongoing state = 〜ている. 住みます sounds like a future plan.

entries.hook: na-adjective negative — most learners miss this
entries.why: na-adjectives negate with じゃない, not くない (that's for i-adjectives).

entries.right: 大好き / すごく好き
entries.why: とても modifies adjectives; for strong liking use 大好き or すごく.
Animals use the counter 匹/匹. Numbers need the right counter, not bare 三.
